newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Widen in US wary bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Widen in US wary bloc.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads generally widened against the dollar bloc as sentiment in the local market remained extremely wary of events in the U.S.

A lack of domestic data this week has left the fate of the market pretty much in the hands of the U.S. in the run-up to the FOMC meeting on March 25, where there remains a possibility of tightening in Fed policy.

"The market may be volatile in the short term with the spread likely to fluctuate in a range of 110-130 basis points with some upside risk," said Su-Lin Ong, fixed income economist at Hambros Bank Australia.

Signs of a strengthening U.S. housing sector saw long-dated Treasury yields spike to their highest level since September last year in New York on Monday, and the market is expected to remain nervous ahead of Wednesday's U.S. CPI.
Canadian and New Zealand bonds were also clouded by the U.S. negative tone.
